CFG-01.behaviour: Config schema rejects unknown keys, bad values and malformed spec IDs

SPEC-01.behaviour: Test titles must start with a known, well-formed spec ID

SPEC-02.behaviour: T1 specs without a test block; T2 gaps only warn

SIZE-01.behaviour: Test files over the line cap and IDs over the per-ID test cap warn

WEAK-01.behaviour: Tests whose only assertions are mock calls or tautologies warn

BAN-01.behaviour: Focused, skipped, todo, empty-each and Stryker-disable block; class, fake-server, loop and T1 snapshot patterns warn

BAN-02.behaviour: Real clock and randomness in tests block unless fake timers or a seed are used

CLOCK-01.behaviour: Suite rerun with the clock shifted reports tests that only fail in the future

DIFF-01.behaviour: Deleting base-branch tests needs the guardrails:tests-removed-approved label; same-PR tests and moves are free; a count drop warns

DIFF-02.behaviour: Removed expects, loosened matchers, lowered tool thresholds and baseline growth block

DIFF-03.behaviour: Loosening guardrails.config.json counts as weakening; tightening does not

BUDGET-01.behaviour: Test budget is per tier, excludes fixtures, handles test-only diffs and only warns

DEPS-01.behaviour: New dependencies block unless listed in deps.allow

ARCH-01.behaviour: Config-declared import boundaries and prod fixture imports are enforced via dependency-cruiser

ARCH-02.behaviour: Duplicate singletons, restricted strings and shipped fixture assets are flagged

ARCH-03.behaviour: Modules unreachable from production entries are reported via knip; CI workflow files never break the run

DOC-01.behaviour: Docs (md/mdx/txt/rst and disguised notes) outside the top-level allowlist or docs.runtime globs warn; required links checked

DOC-02.behaviour: GEMINI.md/CLAUDE.md etc. must be one-line pointers or symlinks to AGENTS.md

DOC-03.behaviour: Allowlisted docs over their line cap warn

MODE-01.behaviour: Rule modes, overrides and config errors decide pass/fail

BASE-01.behaviour: Baselined violations don't block; the ratchet only removes entries

REPORT-01.behaviour: Text and markdown reports show rule, location, message and fix

RULES-01.behaviour: RULES.md documents exactly the rules in the catalogue

INIT-01.behaviour: init scaffolds config, agent pointers, CODEOWNERS and CI without overwriting

INIT-02.behaviour: A fresh init followed by check passes; the runbook and CI standards stay off until init runbook

INIT-03.behaviour: init sets up Codex CLI with an MCP server, an agent marker and a guard hook, appending to an existing config.toml safely

MCP-01.behaviour: MCP server exposes check, report, explain, specs, validate_test, flag and mutants; validate_test checks ID, cap and path

MCP-02.behaviour: The MCP server reports the package.json version

SETUP-02.behaviour: CODEOWNERS must give the config, workflows and baseline an owner

GAME-01.behaviour: Product code that detects the test runner or exits outside CLI entries blocks; expect.extend blocks; self-mocks warn

GAME-02.behaviour: Diff mode: added valueOf/equals/toPrimitive block; counters, cheat comments and literals shared with new expectations warn

FAILBASE-01.behaviour: New or changed tests must fail on the base branch and pass on head, unless regressionGuard or the guardrails:existing-behaviour-tests-approved label

PROP-01.behaviour: Seeded fast-check with a time limit is allowed for properties specs; unseeded runs block

TRIM-01.behaviour: Preference-style TEST-5 bans and missing spec IDs warn; cheating bans block

FLAG-01.behaviour: guardrails flag / guardrails_flag record conflicts; open flags block until resolved; clearing warns

LOCK-01.behaviour: Agent hooks deny edits to spec-tagged tests and guardrails files for Claude Code, Gemini CLI and Antigravity

LOCK-02.behaviour: The Codex hook denies apply_patch and shell writes to locked files, resolving paths from the project root

HOLD-01.behaviour: Holdout tests from a private checkout run at the gate, report titles only, and exempt their specs from TEST-2

DUP-01.behaviour: Duplicated lines in new product code above duplication.maxPercent block

REG-01.behaviour: New packages must exist on npm; young, unpopular or vulnerable packages warn or block; offline skips

SCOPE-01.behaviour: PRs over the product line cap or outside their specs paths warn

WEAK-02.behaviour: Loosening duplication, registry, scope, lock or regressionGuard settings counts as weakening

JOURNEY-01.behaviour: Approved P0/P1 journeys need exactly one e2e test; matrix shows specs, tests and pass/fail

JOURNEY-02.behaviour: Journey config is validated: IDs, spec links, approvedBy and spec back-references; orphan specs warn

JOURNEY-03.behaviour: Journey changes in a PR need a code owner; approve is human-only and hooks deny agent commands

JOURNEY-04.behaviour: New pages, endpoints, router paths and forms not covered by a journey warn

JOURNEY-05.behaviour: journeys draft uses Gemini/OpenAI or a route heuristic; the small-business preset adds drafts

JOURNEY-06.behaviour: journeys draft --dry-run makes no model call and writes nothing

RUN-01.behaviour: RUNBOOK.md has Deploy, Rollback, Smoke, Secrets rotation, Incident first steps in order, each pointing at an npm script (or n/a), no click-paths; standard and referenced scripts exist; length cap

RUN-02.behaviour: Deploy workflows call npm run deploy (no inline deploy commands) and run npm run smoke after; stray runbook/deploy docs outside allowDocs block

RUN-03.behaviour: init runbook writes the template, stubs only missing standard scripts, adds the TESTING.md section and suite baseline, and enables runbook, ci and testSuite without overwriting

RUN-04.behaviour: guardrails smoke does read-only GETs and fails on >= 400; secrets-check verifies required names in a provider list command without printing it

CI-01.behaviour: CI-1 warns when a PR workflow runs the full suite unconditionally, no scheduled full run exists, or deploy scripts lack a full-suite predeploy

CI-02.behaviour: guardrails affected selects tests whose import graph reaches, or whose source names, a changed file; global files select all

SUITE-01.behaviour: check-tests finds banned patterns, oversize files, fixed sleeps, real clock in assertions and copy-paste bodies, and blocks only counts above the baseline (ratchets down)

SUITE-02.behaviour: guardrails check blocks suite regressions, a missing baseline, and a baseline that grew vs the base branch

SUITE-03.behaviour: guardrails shard splits test files into complete, size-balanced shards

SITE-01.behaviour: Site preset validates and scaffolds site files without agent files, preserving existing config unless forced

SITE-02.behaviour: Built-site link checks report broken internal references and resolve valid file trees

SITE-03.behaviour: Link checks ignore external and non-file references and optionally require a home-page contact link

SITE-04.behaviour: Sitemap smoke follows same-origin sitemap paths on the requested preview origin

SITE-05.behaviour: Site workflow uses one guardrails version pin without a guardrails dependency or CUJ steps

CUJ-01.behaviour: Journey schema accepts provenance and bounded closed run steps; rejects unsafe values

CUJ-02.behaviour: Journey tokens resolve dotted paths and report every unresolved or empty token

CUJ-03.behaviour: Approved and client-provided journeys enforce coverage; inferred and template journeys only warn

CUJ-04.behaviour: Journey ownership permits only trusted producer additions and unapproved regeneration using base trust

CUJ-05.behaviour: Journey import validates atomically, rejects protected overwrites and approvals, and is idempotent

CUJ-06.behaviour: Generate stable standalone journey specs with resolved hashes, literal titles, unmanaged-file protection and read-only checks

CUJ-07.behaviour: Execute all closed journey steps with bounded timeouts and contextual failures

CUJ-08.behaviour: Abort unmocked writes while allowing mocked writes and reads

CUJ-09.behaviour: JRN-6 detects stale or edited generated journeys according to enforcement policy

CUJ-10.behaviour: Run journeys with enforcement-aware summaries and scaffold without overwriting

REL-01.behaviour: Release version equals the supplied v-prefixed tag and CHANGELOG has the version heading

REL-02.behaviour: Packed files stay inside the allowlist; no reports, tests, src or env files

REL-03.behaviour: Release workflow only publishes behind an NPM_TOKEN guard and only on v* tags

CLOCK-02.behaviour: checkClock reports exactly the tests that fail only with the clock shifted, passes when nothing fails, treats a suite that is red without the shift as inconclusive, and removes its temp files

DUP-02.behaviour: checkDuplication counts only duplicated lines the PR adds, blocks above duplication.maxPercent, skips tests and fixtures, and reports the percentage metric

LINT-02.behaviour: checkLint blocks and warns on the exact TEST-5 patterns with file, line and message, ignores inline eslint-disable and the project ESLint config, and skips non-test files

ARCH-04.behaviour: checkArch enforces forbidden imports, fixture imports, restricted strings, singletons and reachability with exact files and messages, and respects test and entry exclusions

FAILBASE-02.behaviour: checkFailsOnBase handles renamed and changed tests, helper files, deleted tests, labels, regressionGuard, missing node_modules and always removes its worktree and temp dir

GAME-03.behaviour: checkGaming reports each ARCH-7 signature (test-runner detection, early exit, equality override, expect.extend, self-mock, counters, copied literals, cheat comments) with exact file, line, message, severity and fingerprint, and ignores comments, allowed paths and benign look-alikes

CI-03.behaviour: checkCi reports unconditional full-suite PR runs, missing nightly workflow and missing deploy safety nets with exact file, line, message and fingerprint, and respects scoped, named and guarded commands, na settings and disabled config

MUT-01.behaviour: checkMutation and survivingMutants select mutation-tier targets, run Stryker with the exact config, env and timeout, score only this run's files, block below mutation.break with exact message, and report skipped, not-installed and no-report states

REVIEW-01.behaviour: An optional independent reviewer runs after the checks, sees only the diff and test output through a swappable provider (deterministic stub, external command), never the author reasoning, PR text or commit messages, and turns a fail verdict into REVIEW-1 findings; off by default

REVIEW-02.behaviour: Reviewer input holds only the merge-base diff and test output, is truncated at review.maxDiffBytes, and the command provider runs in an empty temp dir with a scrubbed env, fails closed on timeout, non-zero exit or malformed verdicts

PROV-01.behaviour: Provenance pins the tested commit SHA, report path and hash, guardrails version, checks with results and override labels with who and why into a JSON record and a PR comment marker; a tested SHA that does not match the PR head fails PROV-1; off by default

PROV-02.behaviour: provenance verify accepts the tested SHA or a merge commit whose second parent is the PR head, rejects any other head, a missing record or a changed report hash, and the comment marker round-trips

EVAL-01.behaviour: The checker ledger records escaped bugs and false escalations, and guardrails evaluate diffs it against the rule set to propose prunes and sharpening as a report, never applying them; off by default

EVAL-02.behaviour: guardrails ledger add and import validate entries, dedupe them and append to evaluation.ledgerFile from GitHub event exports without network calls

CFGMD-01.behaviour: guardrails.md front matter and fenced guardrails blocks parse into the same typed config as guardrails.config.json with documented precedence, are locked like the JSON config, and count toward weakening checks

CFGMD-02.behaviour: guardrails.md rejects journeys and deps keys and malformed front matter or blocks with line numbers, and agent hooks lock it

LPLAN-01.behaviour: guardrails labels plan statically scans the diff and lists every approval label the PR will need with reason and file:line, as one markdown summary

LPLAN-02.behaviour: The label planner is advisory: it always exits 0, never adds labels, and omits labels already on the PR

FEED-01.behaviour: Blocking findings are tagged with rule, file and agent and appended to feedback.logFile

FEED-02.behaviour: The weekly feedback job clusters repeated failures and drafts candidate lint rules with a one-line rationale for human approval, never applying them

TELEM-01.behaviour: Telemetry is off unless opted in with an endpoint, is disabled by GUARDRAILS_TELEMETRY=0 or guardrails.md, and sends only the documented anonymous payload

TELEM-02.behaviour: Telemetry sends are fire-and-forget with a timeout and never change a command result or throw

forbidden.name: engine-not-entry
forbidden.message: Checks are a library; entries import them, not the other way round.

restrictedStrings.message: Only the CLI may exit; library code returns results.

na.deploy: Library released by .github/workflows/release.yml on a v* tag; npm publication requires NPM_TOKEN.
na.deploy:preview: No hosted environment; a PR branch build is the preview.
na.rollback: Pin the previous version released by .github/workflows/release.yml on a v* tag; npm unpublish only inside 72 hours.
na.secrets:check: No runtime secrets; the optional journeys draft reads GEMINI/OPENAI keys from the caller environment.

CUJ-INITCHK.title: Developer runs guardrails init in a fresh git repo and the first guardrails check passes
steps: Create a fresh git repository on main with package.json and an entry module
Run guardrails init with a code owner handle and verify scaffolded files without overwriting existing files
Run guardrails check and verify it exits 0 with zero blocking findings and runbook/CI checks kept off

CUJ-NOWEAKEN.title: Branch that deletes a base test or removes an expect is blocked by check --base main unless labelled
steps: Commit spec-tagged base tests on main
Remove an expect call on a feature branch and verify check --base main blocks with TEST-7
Delete a base test on the branch and verify check --base main blocks with TEST-7
Re-run check --base main with GUARDRAILS_LABELS=guardrails:tests-removed-approved and verify the deletion rule passes

CUJ-FAILBASE.title: New test that passes on base is blocked by fails-on-base while a test failing on base and passing on head passes
steps: Commit buggy product code on main in a repository wired to Vitest
Add a new test on a branch that already passes on main and verify check --base main --fails-on-base blocks with TEST-11
Fix the bug and replace the test with one that fails on main and passes on head
Run check --base main --fails-on-base and verify it exits 0

CUJ-FLAG.title: Agent flags a spec conflict with guardrails flag and check blocks until a human empties the flags file
steps: Run guardrails flag with a spec ID and conflict reason in a clean repository
Run guardrails check and verify it exits 1 with FLAG-1
Empty .guardrails/flags.json as a human resolution and verify guardrails check passes

CUJ-BASELINE.title: guardrails baseline records known violations, shrinks when fixed, and blocks baseline growth against base
steps: Run guardrails baseline on a repository with known violations so guardrails check passes
Fix one violation, re-run guardrails baseline, and verify .guardrails/baseline.json shrinks
Commit the baselines on main, grow the baselines on a branch, and verify check --base main blocks with BASE-1 and SUITE-6

CUJ-HOOK.title: guardrails hook-guard --agent claude denies edits to guardrails.config.json and allows them when unlocked
steps: Send a Claude tool call editing guardrails.config.json to guardrails hook-guard --agent claude on stdin
Verify hook-guard exits with code 2 and writes the protection message to stderr
Re-run with GUARDRAILS_ALLOW_TEST_EDITS=1 and verify hook-guard exits with code 0
